name: Standard E-Commerce Order Fulfillment
description: End-to-end processing pipeline from order placement to customer delivery

nodes.label: Receive Order
nodes.description: Customer submits cart; validate order payload and inventory availability.

nodes.label: Authorize Payment
nodes.description: Trigger merchant payment gateway capture call.

nodes.label: Allocate Inventory
nodes.description: Reserve SKU quantities in warehouse database.

nodes.label: Generate Pick List
nodes.description: Create itemized PDF picking sheet from warehouse rack locations.

nodes.label: Item Pick & Pack
nodes.description: Pick physical items, wrap in protective bubble mailer, affix thermal box barcode.

nodes.label: Physical Dispatch & Carrier Handover
nodes.description: Load sealed cartons onto outgoing 3PL commercial trailer without supervisor sign-off.

nodes.label: Final Mile Delivery
nodes.description: Doorstep delivery and capture recipient OTP.

nodes.label: Archive & Close Order
nodes.description: Mark order fulfilled in master accounting ledger.
